findings.message: [DQC.US.0234.10930] The filing is missing a value for the concept TaxJurisdictionOfDomicileExtensibleEnumeration.  When reporting a tax reconcilation, with a value reported for the concept IncomeTaxReconciliationIncomeTaxExpenseBenefitAtFederalStatutoryIncomeTaxRate (with a value of -4,457,000), then a value for TaxJurisdictionOfDomicileExtensibleEnumeration must also be provided to indicate the domestic tax jurisdiction. - lvo20260331_10k.htm 10416
